info.title: DotnetDeployer.Fleet.Tool
info.description: Coordinator and worker CLI for running DotnetDeployer on managed machines.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: DotnetDeployer.Fleet — run DotnetDeployer on managed machines, and query or drive it as a client (also as an MCP server for AI agents)

commands.name: coordinator
commands.description: Start the DotnetDeployer.Fleet coordinator (API server)

options.name: --port
options.description: HTTP port to listen on [default: 5000]

options.name: --data-dir
options.description: Data directory (default: ~/.fleet/coordinator)
